Nobody talks about how lonely being "successful and single" can be. You built a career or a business. You're busy, capable, and surrounded by colleagues - but your closest friends have paired off, moved away, or simply stopped being available on a Tuesday night.

"It's a strange kind of lonely - being surrounded by people all week and nobody to call on a Friday night." - Early Member

Progress rarely happens alone. It comes from the people you learn from, the ideas you swap, and the doors someone else happens to open for you - whether that's a career or a business. Opening those doors is the whole point of this network.

I built the Professional Singles Network because I went looking for a community like this - one part friendship, one part mentorship, and one part collaboration - for people building a career and people building a business alike - and it didn't exist. So I built it.

— Anna, Founder

What We're Built On

Community. Growth. Collaboration.

Three parts of the same need - nobody's asked to pick just one.

01

Community

Founder

"I built the community
I couldn't find."

Fifteen years in health data and enterprise software. A career built around ambitious people - and a social life that, if I'm honest, thinned out faster than I expected.

Work took up most of my time and energy, and as the years went by my circle quietly shrank. Friends moved on with their own lives, and the like-minded, ambitious people around me - the ones who'd actually understand what I was building - became harder and harder to find.

What I actually craved was a community - somewhere to keep learning, exploring, and building alongside other people. I wanted a room full of people who understood the ambition and the isolation that can come with it - some to be friends with, some to learn from, some to build something with.

I couldn't find a community like that, so I built it myself.

- Anna, Founder

Inside The Network

Here's what's waiting for you.

01

The Intro Call

Free

Your way in. A relaxed 1:1 conversation with Anna about you - your career, what's missing socially, and what you're hoping to find here. No pressure, no sales pitch.

02

Monthly Networking Calls

A standing monthly Zoom session for the whole network - the kind of room where a career conversation turns into a business idea, or a stranger becomes the person who opens a door for you. Low-effort, high-value.

03

Mentor & Mentee Programme

Paired by experience and ambition. Bring your biggest challenge to the table. Become a mentor yourself and unlock special member privileges - enquire within.

04

Co-Working Days

A room full of members getting their heads down together - real work, real momentum, and a coffee break with people who get it.

05

Professional Workshops

Small Fee

AI tools for your role, business fundamentals, personal branding, negotiation, leadership, financial literacy, public speaking, and career pivots - open to everyone in the network for a small fee per session.

06

Social Meet-Ups

Pub quizzes, dinners, drinks, and casual catch-ups - the low-key ways members actually get to know each other.

07

Getaway Weekends

Seasonal retreats and annual trips away with the network - open to all members, priced per trip.

08

Creative & Recreational Workshops

Golf days, clay pigeon shooting, wine tasting, cookery classes, and pottery workshops - the kind of shared experience that turns acquaintances into friends.

Also available: seasonal socials, and members-only experiences.

Membership

Free to join. Free to belong.

Meeting Anna costs nothing, and neither does the community itself - the mentor programme and the monthly calls are free for everyone. Workshops and in-person events are priced separately, open to all. Whether you're growing a career or a business, it's built for both.

Free

It starts with getting to know you.

One membership. Everything included. No card required.

  • ✓A 1:1 introduction call with Anna
  • ✓She gets to know you, your goals, and what you're after

  • ✓Access to self-development & business workshops (small fee)

No fees, ever. Leave anytime, no strings attached.

How It Works

What are the steps?

This is the whole reason it's free - Anna wants to know you before you decide whether this is your kind of network.

Complete The Questionnaire

A Real Conversation

Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

What does the free intro call actually involve?

A relaxed 30 minute conversation with Anna about your career, your social circle, and what you're hoping to get out of the network. There's no obligation to join afterwards - you'll simply be kept informed of upcoming events either way.

What kind of events do you run?

Social nights (pub quizzes, wine tasting, cocktail making), creative workshops, travel and adventures, outdoor activities, online socials, and live experiences such as concerts, theatre and comedy. You can sign up to hear about future events.

What kind of workshops do you run?

AI tools for your industry, career development, personal branding, negotiation, business fundamentals - built around what professionals and entrepreneurs are actually asking for.

How do mentor circles work?

Small groups matched by experience and ambition, meeting monthly to work through real professional challenges together.

What cities do you operate in?

At the moment, we are based in London. However, some of our events are online.

Do I need to run my own business to join?

Not at all. Entrepreneurs, established business owners, and people building a career inside a company are all equally welcome - the workshops, mentoring, and network are built to serve career growth and business growth alike.
